chair.name: chair
chair.title: Chair
chair.notes: Print upright, as shown. PLA, 0.2 mm layers, 3 walls, 15 % infill, no supports.
chair.about:
A chair for the Moomin House, sized for Moomintroll, that prints upright with no supports.

The four legs are what is left of a solid block after two pointed tunnels are cut through it, front to back and
side to side. Their roofs lean 45°, the most an FDM printer prints without support, so the seat needs none. The
back is a slab with an arched top. The outer corners, the seat and the back are rounded; the bottom edges stay
sharp, because a rounded bottom edge would overhang.

checks.label: Closed solid
checks.detail: Watertight, every edge shared by two faces.

checks.label: Fits the printer
checks.detail: 34.0 × 32.0 × 47.0 mm on a 220 × 220 × 250 mm build volume.

checks.label: No supports needed
checks.detail: Nothing leans out more than 45° from vertical.

checks.label: Walls thick enough
checks.detail: Thinnest wall 3.50 mm (at least 1.2 mm; 393 places measured).

checks.label: Too big to swallow
checks.detail: Does not fit the Ø31.7 × 57.1 mm small-parts cylinder (EN 71-1).

table.name: table
table.title: Round table
table.notes: Print upright, as shown. PLA, 0.2 mm layers, 3 walls, 15 % infill, no supports.
table.about:
A round table for the Moomin House on one flared pedestal, printed upright with no supports.

The column widens into the table top in a 45° cone, the most an FDM printer prints without support, so the
underside of the top needs none. The top's upper edge and the foot are rounded.
